description: Review the immediate impact of changing mapped nodes. Returns the selected nodes, their direct neighbors in either direction, and edges between them from the published graph.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the preceding page of this same query. Omit for the first page; do not construct or reuse across projects.

executionId.description: Execution record ID returned when the execution was registered; associates this call with that execution. Not a session or project ID.

nodeIds.description: Selected node IDs from this project's published graph, not file paths or nodes from another project.

pageSize.description: Maximum items requested per page, within the schema limits. Continue with the returned nextCursor when present.

projectId.description: Owned Brain Scanner project ID from the account's project list; not a local path or repository URL.

sessionId.description: ID of this project's active agent session, returned when the session was started. Not needed for read-only calls.

name: analyze_impact
title: Analyze impact
